#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

ll powerMod(ll b, ll e, ll m) {
    ll x = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e % 2 == 1)
            x = (b * x) % m;
        b = (b * b) % m;
        e /= 2;
    }
    return x;
}

ll computeAnswer(ll n, ll m, int L, int R, ll mod) {
    ll inv2 = powerMod(2, mod - 2, mod);
    ll diff = R - L + 1;
    ll p1 = diff / 2;
    ll p2 = diff - p1;
    ll nm = n * m;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        return powerMod(diff, nm, mod);
    } else {
        ll pp1 = diff;
        ll pp2 = abs(p1 - p2);
        ll opt1 = powerMod(pp1, nm, mod);
        ll opt2 = powerMod(pp2, nm, mod);
        ll opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod;
        opt = (opt * inv2) % mod;
        return opt;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ll n, m;
    int L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;
    ll mod = 998244353;
    ll ans = computeAnswer(n, m, L, R, mod);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
